-- `GetText(TOKEN, nil, n)` is the reference's plural-aware GlobalString lookup, and it -- lives in `LocaleProperties.lua`, which this house does not transcribe. "_P1") if p1 then return p1 end end return getglobal(token) end
-- The ref's own `IsEnabled() == 0` (FriendsFrame.lua l.404), which works here again: -- IsEnabled answers the NUMBER 1 or 0 (button.rs, wow-re button-enabled-state.md). This -- used to read BOTH spellings because the engine returned a boolean, and the dual read -- went with that divergence rather than outliving it as the workaround that hides it. local function guildButtonDisabled(button) return button:IsEnabled() == 0 end
-- The page button and the view's squeezable column share one rule: a visible scroll bar -- takes width off the middle column and pulls the button 23px left. -- Ref l.957-978. `GetGuildRosterLastOnline` answers (years, months, days, hours) and the -- formatter takes the COARSEST non-zero unit — "3 months", never "3 months 2 days". All -- four zero reads "< an hour", which is also what a member who logged off minutes ago -- gets. The ref leaks its four locals as globals (no `local` on l.958); ours are local. function GuildFrame_GetLastOnline(guildIndex) local year, month, day, hour = GetGuildRosterLastOnline(guildIndex) local lastOnline if (year == 0) or (year == nil) then if (month == 0) or (month == nil) then if (day == 0) or (day == nil) then if (hour == 0) or (hour == nil) then lastOnline = LASTONLINE_MINS else lastOnline = format(guildPlural("LASTONLINE_HOURS", hour), hour) end else lastOnline = format(guildPlural("LASTONLINE_DAYS", day), day) end else lastOnline = format(guildPlural("LASTONLINE_MONTHS", month), month) end else lastOnline = format(guildPlural("LASTONLINE_YEARS", year), year) end return lastOnline end
